title: Effect of cover crops on subsequent corn (maize) yield
research_question: Do cover crops (winter annual species grown between cash crop seasons) affect subsequent corn/maize yield compared to no cover crop (fallow)?

population.description: Corn (maize) grown after winter cover crop termination in temperate field experiments

intervention.description: Winter cover crop grown before corn (any species: rye, vetch, clover, radish, etc.)

comparator.description: No cover crop (winter fallow, bare soil) before corn
comparator.definition: Same corn crop grown without a preceding cover crop

primary.description: Corn (maize) grain yield following cover crop vs fallow
primary.direction_of_interest: neutral to slightly positive (cover crops may slightly increase or decrease corn yield)

intervention: Winter cover crop before corn (any species)
control: No cover crop (winter fallow/bare soil) before corn
primary_outcomes: Corn (maize) grain yield following cover crop termination
typical_effect_size: -1% to +3% corn yield change (small, near zero)
important_moderators: Cover crop species (rye, vetch, clover, radish, mixture)
Cover crop type (grass, legume, brassica, mixture)
Cover crop termination method (herbicide, rolling-crimping, tillage)
Climate zone / region (US Midwest, Southeast, etc.)
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract CORN YIELD for BOTH cover crop AND no-cover-crop (fallow) treatments
2. Control = no cover crop (fallow); Treatment = with cover crop before corn
3. If multiple cover crop species tested, extract EACH vs same fallow control
5. Record cover crop species and termination method
6. Focus on CORN GRAIN YIELD, not cover crop biomass or soil properties
tc_confusion_warnings: Control is NO COVER CROP (fallow); Treatment is WITH COVER CROP
Do NOT confuse cover crop biomass with corn yield — the outcome is CORN yield
Some papers report both corn and soybean in rotation — extract CORN years only
Cover crop N contribution may affect corn N response — record N rate as moderator
Legume cover crops (vetch, clover) expected to increase corn yield more than grass covers (rye)
US units: bu/ac (bushels per acre) — convert to Mg/ha: multiply by 0.0628

search.seed_papers_description: Marcillo & Miguez 2017 (Journal of Soil and Water Conservation, meta-analysis of cover crop effects on corn and soybean yield)

inclusion_criteria: Primary field experiment comparing cover crop vs no-cover-crop before corn/maize
Reports corn/maize grain yield data (numeric means)
Includes both cover crop treatment and fallow/bare control
exclusion_criteria: Only reports cover crop biomass or soil properties without corn yield
Tropical perennial systems (not annual cover crop rotation)
No fallow/bare control (comparing cover crop species only)
Greenhouse or pot experiment (field only for this topic)

benchmark.source: Marcillo & Miguez 2017 (Journal of Soil and Water Conservation 72(3):226-239)

published_pooled_effect.notes: Approximate corn yield change after cover crop. Effect near zero but slightly positive. Legume covers show larger positive effect. JSWC is moderate OA.
